title: DatasetAvailableEvent
description: Integration event published by an upstream producer when a vendor CSV file is ready for processing. Consumed by the DatasetProcessingFunction from the 'raw-energy-events' Service Bus queue.

DatasetId.description: Unique identifier for this dataset ingestion. Used as the partition key in the Bronze layer.

StoragePath.description: Storage URI of the vendor CSV file. abfss:// scheme in production; http:// accepted for local emulator.

VendorId.description: Vendor identifier. Combined with SchemaVersion to look up the VendorSchemaMapping in the schema registry.

SchemaVersion.description: Schema version string (e.g. 'v2'). Combined with VendorId to select the correct ColumnMappings.

CorrelationId.description: W3C traceparent-compatible correlation ID. Optional — if absent or null the processing function generates a new Guid-based value and logs a warning. Propagated to all outbound events and OTel spans (FR-003).

PublishedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event publication.
